dedupeResult: The complete active pull-request patch and current branch search surface were checked for both label names, canonical domains and public submission mailboxes before creation. No existing music-submission-agent route records were found for Muti Music or Odyzey Music. Each label's public mailbox and native contact form were consolidated into one opportunity because they are alternate first-party contact paths for the same label submission decision.
emailVerificationLevel: Muti Music publishes label@mutimusic.com under Demos/Inquiries on its official contact page. Odyzey Music publishes music@odyzeymusic.com specifically for Submissions on its official contact page. Both addresses were checked only for first-party publication, syntax, domain alignment and stated business purpose. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probe was performed.
safety: No email, contact form, demo or submission was sent; no track, streaming link, private link, download link, attachment, audio, artwork, biography, metadata or personal data was supplied; no account, login, cookie, CAPTCHA, anti-spam, anti-bot, payment or subscription workflow was used; no contact was guessed; and no SMTP/MX/deliverability probing was performed.
